donation_channel.quote: प्रधानमन्त्री दैवी प्रकोप उद्धार कोष र प्रधानमन्त्री राहत कोषमा आर्थिक सहयोग गरिदिनु हुन
donation_channel.note: Nepali text ("...contribute financial support to the Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund and Prime Minister Relief Fund") appears on the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers (OPMCM) homepage, gov.np domain, alongside a QR code for contributions. No bank account number was visible in the extracted text (not transcribed here regardless per the no-account-number rule). Two separate funds are actually named ('Prime Minister Divine Calamity Relief Fund' and 'Prime Minister Relief Fund') — recorded as one entry per the task's ask; could not find a deeper dedicated page for either fund within budget (ndrrma.gov.np, the other candidate checked, does not mention either fund).

research_notes: Added so the state relief fund appears on the board like any other recipient rather than being the one obvious destination the site never names. The OPMCM homepage carries the call for contributions and a QR code; no account number is transcribed here or stored anywhere, per the donation-channel rule. Two funds are named on that page (Prime Minister Divine Calamity Relief Fund and Prime Minister Relief Fund) and no deeper dedicated page for either was reachable within the research budget, so they are recorded as one entry. ndrrma.gov.np, the other government candidate checked, mentions neither.
